column1: # Ferriboot layout for a 4 MiB ESP32-C3.
# * Stock ESP-IDF Secure Boot V2 second stage: flash 0x0
#   partition table at 0x10000. The ROM verifies its RSA-3072 signature.
# * Signed factory ESP application at 0x20000 (0x40000 reserved) is Ferriboot
#   the third stage. ESP-IDF checks its RSA-3072 signature before executing it.
# * NVS/phy_init are ESP support partitions; Ferriboot does not use them.
# * Slots are data/undefined and found by label.
# * The 0x1000 MCUboot header means slot partitions start at ...F000 so the
#   actual ESP payloads begin at 0x70000 / 0x230000
# * Equal 1764 KiB slots (441 sectors)
